workLog.step: Re-measured the issue's premise before acting on it. #3649 states that PR #3505 already fixed four non-eval files: scripts/github_core/gh_client.py, scripts/detect_scope_explosion.py, scripts/validation/spec_contradiction.py, scripts/ai_review_common/workflow.py. An AST scan found those four to be the top four violators, at 5, 5, 5 and 4 calls respectively.

Confirmed the premise is wrong rather than trusting either source. Read gh_client.py directly: four subprocess.run calls carry capture_output=True and text=True with no encoding and no errors. git log -S'errors="replace"' on that path returns no commit, so the keyword was never added. PR #3505 merged 2026-07-28 but never touched those files. The issue understates its own scope.

Measured the real scope with an AST walk rather than a regex. A call is in scope when it targets subprocess.run, check_output, Popen, check_call or call, and carries a capture keyword (capture_output or stdout) together with a text keyword (text or universal_newlines). Result: 84 captured-text calls, 71 of them missing at least one codec keyword, across 44 files.

Classified call shapes before writing any automated edit, so the fixer could not corrupt a file it did not understand. 69 of 71 are multi-line calls whose text keyword sits alone on its own line. 2 are not: scripts/invoke_pr_maintenance.py:60 is a single-line call and scripts/issue_triage.py:448 packs several keywords onto one line. The fixer handled the 69 and reported the 2 for manual edit.

Ran the fixer: 42 files, 69 calls. Every changed file was re-parsed with ast.parse afterwards and all parsed clean. Edited the two remaining call sites by hand, expanding both to the multi-line form. Re-ran the scan: 0 violations remaining.

Checked the lint baseline at pristine origin/main before assuming the change caused anything. Extracted all 44 files at origin/main into a scratch tree. Pristine main already reports 1 ruff error (a pre-existing E501 on a long regex in validate_review_marker.py) and 22 files that ruff format would reformat. The branch reports the identical 1 error and identical 22 files, so this change adds zero new lint or format debt. Reformatting was correctly skipped as unrelated churn.

Searched for an existing scanner before building one. Nothing under scripts/validation or scripts/ci matched by name or by content, so scripts/validation/subprocess_encoding.py is net-new. It follows the repository CLI convention: exit 0 clean, exit 1 violations found, exit 2 the scan could not run.

Verified the scanner in both directions with the exit code read directly rather than through a pipe. An earlier check reported the wrong result because 'cmd | tail; echo $?' reports tail's exit code, not the scanner's. Read correctly: reverting one file yields exit 1 with 5 findings, and the clean tree yields exit 0.

Wrote 14 tests covering positive, negative, edge and CLI-contract cases. Negative controls assert that a byte-mode reader, a non-capturing call and a lookalike object that merely has a run attribute are all ignored, because each of those cannot hit the defect and flagging them would be a false positive.

Mutation tested every new scanner component individually to prove each is load-bearing. Dropping errors from REQUIRED fails 2 tests. Dropping universal_newlines from TEXT_KEYWORDS fails 1. Dropping stdout from CAPTURE_KEYWORDS fails 1. Accepting any string literal instead of the exact value fails 1. Removing the directory check fails 1. Restored: 14 of 14 green.

Wired the gate into .github/workflows/pytest.yml as a one-line blocking invocation next to the existing Python syntax gate. It blocks rather than ratchets because the tree is now at zero. The invocation is one line, so the ADR-006 run-block ratchet still reports 71 against --max 71 and did not move.

Ran the full repository suite and found 17 failures caused by this change, in two groups. Group one: 4 files under scripts/ are mirrored into .claude/lib, .claude/skills/review/scripts and src/copilot-cli/skills/review/scripts, so the copies had drifted. Regenerated with scripts/sync_plugin_lib.py and build/scripts/build_all.py. Group two: 12 tests pin the exact subprocess call shape through a mock or a fake.

Updated the 12 shape-pinning tests to assert the new keywords rather than to ignore them, so the pin stays meaningful. RunRecorder in tests/ci/test_ruff_ratchet.py now asserts errors == "replace" alongside the encoding assertion it already carried, and the fake_run in tests/ci/test_pr_validation_workflow.py asserts both. That keeps these tests as live pins on the call shape instead of widening them into no-ops.

Bumped both shipped plugin manifests to 0.6.187, .claude and src/copilot-cli, because both trees carry regenerated files. src/claude was untouched by this change so its manifest stayed at 0.3.53. The parity and hook guard suites pass, 54 tests.
Re-ran the full repository suite after every fix: 17462 passed, 26 skipped, 0 failed in 327s.

Mutation tested the regression guard end to end. Reverting a single production file to its origin/main content fails TestTheRepositoryItselfIsClean and nothing else, which proves the guard actually watches the tree rather than only the synthetic fixtures. Restored: 14 of 14 green.

Split the change on the repository's own scope gate rather than bypassing it. The combined branch was 61 files against a 50-file hard limit, and SKIP_SCOPE_CHECK=1 exists but is documented for justified large PRs only. Splitting is feasible here, so the gate was walked: part 1 is the 39 unmirrored sweep files plus the 5 shape-pinning tests, part 2 is the 5 mirrored sources with their regenerated plugin copies, the manifest bumps and the scanner. Part 2 wires the gate at the moment the tree reaches zero, which is more correct than wiring it while violations remain.

nextSteps: The gate scopes to scripts/ because that is what #3649 asked for and what is now at zero. Extending it to build/, tests/ and .claude/ would need those trees measured and burned down first.
The pre-existing E501 in scripts/validation/validate_review_marker.py and the 22 files that ruff format would reformat are untouched repository debt, not regressions from this change.
